result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: content is being clipped/cut off at the right and bottom edges of the screen, affecting visibility of restaurant cards and category filters.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally cut off on the right side, truncating the restaurant name and details
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scrolling or card width to ensure all three cards in the carousel are fully visible and properly aligned within the viewport

issues.description: The category filter pills have a partially visible category on the far right that is cut off, indicating horizontal overflow
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has proper padding and that all filter pills are fully visible, or implement a scrollable carousel with visible scroll indicators

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is vertically cut off, showing only the pizza image without the restaurant name, delivery time, rating, or other details
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom padding to the scroll container or adjust page layout to ensure the last visible item shows complete information, not just an image cutoff
